faq_heading: New construction in Cloverdale: your questions answered

faq.q: What have houses in Cloverdale sold for?
faq.a: 234 houses sold in Cloverdale at a median of $1,300,000, with the middle half between $1,135,750 and $1,500,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Cloverdale?

faq.q: Which homes in Cloverdale are the newest?

items.t: 234 houses sold in Cloverdale at a median of $1,300,000 (middle half $1,135,750 to $1,500,000). A typical house in Cloverdale spent 20 days on the market and closed at 96.7% of the asking price.
In Cloverdale, townhomes sold at a median of $752,000 across 116 sales, and the middle half closed between $688,750 and $826,225. The median townhome sat 21 days and sold for 97.7% of list.
Cloverdale: 55 condos sold at a median of $470,000, with the middle half between $403,750 and $571,500. The median condo took 34 days to sell and closed at 96.8% of list.
9 duplexes sold in Cloverdale at a median of $1,173,000 (middle half $1,010,000 to $1,300,000). A typical duplex in Cloverdale spent 17 days on the market and closed at 95.6% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
